glosses: To give new life, energy or strength to someone or something; to revitalize.

examples.text: The attraction that it exerts on the millions that stroll through its maze of information might be used to reinvigorate our cities. Cyberflaneurs have become captivated with the Internet's ready supply of huge amounts of information...
